description_en: Attaches one or more RDS instances to a scaling group, which allows you to adjust the number of RDS instances in the scaling group at any time to increase flexibility and usability
description_zh: 通过调用API AttachDBInstances为伸缩组添加一个或多个RDS实例，可实现根据您的需要随时调整伸缩组内的RDS实例数量，增加您使用上的灵活性与实用性
kebab_example: aliyun ess attach-db-instances --scaling-group-id asg-bp1avr6ensitts3w0000 --db-instances rm-bp12cy30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachDBInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add the private IP addresses of all instances in the current scaling group to the IP address whitelist of the RDS instances when the RDS instances are attached to the scaling group. Valid values:

true: Adds the private IP addresses.

false: Does not add the private IP addresses.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
当RDS实例添加到伸缩组时，是否把当前伸缩组内实例的私网IP全部添加到RDS实例IP白名单中。取值范围：

true：添加。

false：不添加。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_attach

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotence of the request. You can generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the parameter value is unique across different requests.

The value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the RDS instances
parameters.name: db_instances

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The association mode between the scaling group and the database. Valid values:

SecurityIp: The SecurityIp mode. In this mode, the IP addresses of scaled-out instances are automatically added to the IP address whitelist of the database. Currently, only ApsaraDB RDS databases support this mode.
SecurityGroup: The security group mode. In this mode, the security group of the scaling configuration is added to the security group whitelist of the database for association and registration.

Default value: SecurityIp
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组与数据库关联方式。取值范围：

SecurityIp：修改SecurityIp（即数据库的IP白名单）模式，通过将扩容实例自动添加到数据库白名单（目前仅RDS数据库支持）。
SecurityGroup：安全组模式，通过将伸缩配置安全组添加至数据库安全组白名单关联注册。

默认值：SecurityIp
parameters.name: attach_mode

parameters.help_en:
The database type. Valid values:

RDS
Redis
MongoDB

Default value: RDS
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型。取值范围：

RDS。
Redis。
MongoDB。

默认值：RDS
parameters.name: type
